known_issue_themes.criterion: Triangle-containing fixture is outside nearest-neighbor cubic lattice domain.
Global iff overclaims constant-rule cases and/or lacks arbitrary-component noncancellation proof.
Components with zero recorded attachments also contribute constants.
Finite static measures do not establish complete all-axiom model counterexamples.
Averaging transfers appropriate uniform linear bounds, not arbitrary nonlinear law properties.
Submitted changed-claim graph omits actual named premise dependencies.

scoring: Root independently checks each report against original source; credit substantiated equivalent reasoning, not matching keywords. Separate materiality and new valid issues; report false positives and omissions. Packet coverage and control quality are separate from issue count.
bias: Same known-defective PR chosen after prior pilot. Fresh model contexts are blind, but this is not an unbiased sample of repository PRs or a replacement-safety estimate.
